THE SOURCE

Claim for claim. Number for number.

All 23 topics, pictures and level groupings match the original game. Each reveal keeps its CEA claim word for word and answers it with a sourced number about Trump or Republican policy.

The CEA scored the worst case for policies that were never enacted. We use the worst case its own sources report for policies that were: the top of each range, the longest horizon, the peak year and the hardest-hit households.

Every number below is real and linked. Some measure the same harm from different angles, so the jobs, energy, deficit and interest cards should not be added together.

Sources checked October 20, 2026.
